findings.title: F9 / D-R24-11: 'the EN timing figures stand' is false under the record's own 50 nA bound for D402
findings.contradicts: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md F9: 'D402 leaks at most 50 nA at 15 V (Infineon ESD103 Rev 1.3), which moves EN by at most 5.7 mV with J400 closed, so the EN timing figures stand (Calculation ...)'; R10_DECISIONS D-R24-11 'EN' bullets ('the same as 25 nA at the EN node, a quarter of the 0.1 uA EN leakage D-R20-11's timing already carries. The EN timing figures are kept'). The figures are D-R20-11's worst case (10.6 / 20.5 / 26.4 ms at 6.0 / 7.4 / 8.4 V, 8.5 ms at 5.73 V, 6.6 ms at 5.5 V, pack >= 5.92 V for 10 ms, turn-on 30-129 ms), quoted in F4, F6, F9 and the Accepted-risks list.
findings.evidence: Board: D402 B(4.45,65.9) pad 1 BAT_SW_RETURN (J400.2 node, R165.1), pad 2 GND; R80 / R165 470k 1 %, R81 300k 1 %, C87 220 nF. ESD103-B1-02EL datasheet Rev 1.3 Table 3: IR max 50 nA at VR = 15 V (no lower-voltage maximum). Model (.supervisor/r24_requirements/en_timing.py) = D-R20-11's method (C87 0.72-1.27 x, 1 % divider, EN 1.183-1.223 V rising / 1.076-1.116 V falling, I_ENLKG +/-0.1 uA); it reproduces D-R20-11 exactly with D402 = 0 (6.58 / 8.50 / 10.65 / 20.47 / 26.41 ms; 5.917 V; 30.3-128.6 ms). Two errors in the record's reasoning: (1) the +/-0.1 uA in D-R20-11 is U9's own EN pin leakage (SLVSFC9C p9), so D402's leakage adds to it rather than fitting inside it; (2) during a J400 drop-out the source (R80) is disconnected, J400.2 floats on R165 and D402, so the clamp drains C87 with its full current through R165 (50 nA at EN, not 25 nA). With D402 at the 50 nA bound the record itself uses: drop-out immunity 6.30 ms at 5.5 V, 8.20 ms at 5.73 V, 10.35 ms at 6.0 V, 20.11 ms at 7.4 V, 26.02 ms at 8.4 V; pack for the 10 ms criterion 5.956 V (was 5.92 V); turn-on 30.4-130.3 ms (was 30-129 ms).
findings.impact: Worst-case figures that F4 (flight-2 pack option '>= 5.92 V under four stalls'), F6 (bench acceptance, 8.5 ms at 5.73 V) and F9 rely on are stated about 0.3 ms / 0.04 V optimistic; no safety effect (6.0 V still above 10 ms).
findings.concrete_fix: Either restate the D-R20-11 figures with D402's bound added (10.3 / 20.1 / 26.0 ms, 8.2 ms at 5.73 V, 6.3 ms at 5.5 V, pack >= 5.96 V for 10 ms, turn-on 30-130 ms) in F4, F6, F9, Accepted risks, AGENTS, M3_R10 and the binding-note obligation; or cite a datasheet maximum for D402's leakage at <= 5.3 V that makes the change negligible and say so, replacing the 'quarter of the 0.1 uA' argument.

findings.title: P3 landing load: 8.0 m/s at 20 mm crush is 163 g, not 168 g
findings.contradicts: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md P3: 'a = v^2 / 2s with s = 20 mm crush. A 36 in flat chute gives 6.2-8.0 m/s, so 98-168 g (Inference)'; repeated in docs/ORDERING.md 8.4 'Sled/supports' and docs/R10_VALIDATION.md owner rows 12 and 32.
findings.evidence: 8.0^2 / (2 x 0.020) = 1600 m/s^2 = 163.2 g (g = 9.80665). 168 g needs 8.11 m/s. The source (round23_mechanics.md R23-MECHANICS-02) used 6.1-8.1 m/s -> 95-168 g; the requirement narrowed the speed range to 6.2-8.0 but kept 168. The lower end (6.2 m/s -> 98.0 g) is consistent.
findings.impact: Stated result does not follow from its stated input (about 3 % high); the 2 x option (about 330 g) and the sled-relief conclusion are unchanged.
findings.concrete_fix: Write '6.2-8.0 m/s, so 98-163 g' (or keep 168 g with '6.2-8.1 m/s') in P3, ORDERING 8.4 and R10_VALIDATION rows 12 and 32.

findings.title: P2's J2 land distances to the (4,44.3) support are pad-bounding-box figures, not the round lands
findings.contradicts: docs/REQUIREMENTS.md P2: 'the exposed GND, 3V3 and NRST lands at LED2, LED1 and J2 lie only 3.808-3.918 mm from the (4,44.3) support centre'; docs/M3_R10.md (J2.1 3.871 mm, J2.3 3.918 mm), R10_VALIDATION line ~2645, ORDERING 8.4, R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF.
findings.evidence: Board (pcbnew, F.Cu, mask expansion 0 on board and pads): J2 (TC2030) pads are circles Ø0.7874 mm; J2.1 (3V3) centre (3.73, 40.035) -> 4.2735 - 0.3937 = 3.880 mm; J2.3 (NRST) centre (5.0, 40.035) -> 4.3807 - 0.3937 = 3.987 mm. The recorded 3.871 / 3.918 mm are the distances to the pads' bounding squares (nearest corner/edge: 44.3 - 40.429 = 3.871; sqrt(0.606^2 + 3.871^2) = 3.918). LED2.2 3.808 and LED1.1 3.860 (rectangular pads) are correct. True range 3.808-3.987 mm.
findings.impact: Measured values in the requirement contradict the board (conservative direction); the nylon-hardware requirement and its 3.8 mm gate conclusion are unchanged.
findings.concrete_fix: Replace 3.871 / 3.918 with 3.880 / 3.987 mm and the range with 3.808-3.987 mm in P2, M3_R10, R10_VALIDATION, ORDERING 8.4 and R10_VEHICLE_HANDOFF (or state that the figures are bounding-box distances).
